content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hi, thank you for sending over the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to propose a few small adjustments before I sign. Specifically, regarding the relevant clause, you are required to perform extra work that is not specifically listed in the agreement if the company considers it necessary, without a guaranteed increase in pay; I suggest modifying this so that the Contractor shall provide only the specific services set forth in this Agreement, and any additional services requested by the Client shall be subject to a separate written agreement and additional compensation. Thank you for understanding, and I look forward to finalizing this. Best regards,
